title: 10K Races in Malaysia: 2026 JomRun Series Guide
intro: Four races anchor this stretch of Malaysia's 2026 calendar, all part of the JomRun-powered series and all offering the same 21.1/10/5km lineup so a 10K sits alongside a half marathon and 5K at every stop. The season runs from mid-August through the end of October, starting in Kuala Lumpur, moving to Rawang in Selangor, then Johor Bahru, and finishing in Kuala Terengganu on the east coast. September is the busiest month with two races three weeks apart. The choice comes down mainly to location and timing rather than distance options, since every event covers the same three race lengths.

faqs.question: Which of these Malaysia 10K races comes first in 2026?
faqs.answer: The KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® in Kuala Lumpur leads the calendar on 2026-08-16. It's followed by the Rawang Half Marathon on 2026-09-13, the Tebrau City Half Marathon in Johor Bahru on 2026-09-20, and the Terengganu Half Marathon on 2026-10-31.

faqs.question: Do all four races offer a 10K distance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every race in this set - in Kuala Lumpur, Rawang, Johor Bahru, and Kuala Terengganu - runs the same 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances, so a 10K entrant has the same distance choice available at each stop on the calendar.

faqs.question: How far apart are the September races in Selangor and Johor?
